subject: RECEIVE statement
notes: kb/Work PB4744 (slice S4 of DESIGN-message-control.md): An unsuccessful RECEIVE takes the ON EXCEPTION phrase; without one the condition, when its checking is enabled, selects a WHEN phrase or a USE declarative (EmitOutcome over EmitSelection), else control reaches the end of the statement. It replaces the owner decision R43 non-support that held this row while the facility was declined.
